fullPassage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② seeing → to see: disallow는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 to see
det.analysis:
✅ ① recognize: 'is to recognize the functional operations'에서 to부정사의 동사원형 — 적절

✅ ③ involved: 'many levels of management involved in decision making'에서 management를 수식하는 과거분사 — 적절

✅ ④ are: 'Organic structures are more horizontal'에서 주어 structures(복수)에 맞는 동사 — 적절
det.tip: disallow A to부정사: disallow them to see (O) / disallow them seeing (X)

questions.passage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "<u>tunnel vision</u>" which disallows them to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 tunnel vision이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 'tunnel vision' = 자기 부서의 편향된 관점에만 갇혀 다른 사람처럼 사물을 보지 못하는 좁은 시야
det.analysis:
❌ ① 터널의 두려움: 물리적 터널이 아닌 비유적 표현

❌ ② 시력 질병: 의학적 질병이 아니라 관점의 협소함을 뜻함

❌ ③ 뛰어난 통찰력: 터널 시야는 넓은 통찰이 아니라 좁은 시야를 의미

✅ ④ 자기 부서 관점에만 갇힌 좁은 시야: 'tunnel vision which disallows them to see things as others see them'에서 자기 부서의 편향에 갇혀 다른 시각을 보지 못하는 좁은 시야를 뜻함 ←정답
det.tip: tunnel vision = 터널 시야(좁은 시야). disallows them to see as others do

ch: 어두운 터널을 지날 때 느끼는 두려움
나이가 들며 시력이 점점 나빠지는 질병
자기 부서 관점에만 갇혀 다른 시각을 보지 못하는 좁은 시야

questions.passage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows <u>them</u> to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 'disallows them to see'의 them은 앞의 a department and its members(한 부서와 그 구성원들)를 가리킴
det.analysis:
❌ ① 다른 조직들: 본문의 지시 대상이 아님

✅ ② 한 부서와 그 구성원들: 'A department and its members will acquire tunnel vision which disallows them to see things'에서 them은 터널 시야를 얻은 주체인 a department and its members를 가리킴 ←정답

❌ ③ 조직 구조들: 구조는 뒤 문장들의 주제로 them과 무관

❌ ④ 관리 단계들: 관리 단계는 기계적 구조 설명의 일부로 them과 무관
det.tip: A department and its members ... disallows them → them = 부서와 구성원들

ch: 한 부서와 그 구성원들(a department and its members)

questions.passage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to __________. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: '다른 사람처럼 사물을 보다(see things as others see them)' — 터널 시야가 이를 못하게 함
det.analysis:
❌ ① change their own department rules(자기 부서 규칙을 바꾸다): 터널 시야의 효과와 무관

❌ ② follow every company procedure(모든 회사 절차를 따르다): 좁은 시야의 결과와 다름

✅ ③ see things as others see them(다른 사람처럼 사물을 보다): 'tunnel vision which disallows them to _____'에서 터널 시야가 다른 사람처럼 보는 것을 못하게 한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답

❌ ④ work closely with other teams(다른 팀과 긴밀히 협력하다): 시각의 협소함과 직접 연결되지 않음
det.tip: disallows them to _____ → 다른 사람처럼 사물을 보다

ch: see things as others see them

questions.passage: The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own __________ (bias) and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to see things as others see them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 명사 perspective를 수식하며 prejudiced와 병렬되는 과거분사형 형용사 biased
det.analysis: 'their own __________ and prejudiced perspective'에서 명사 perspective를 수식하고 과거분사형 형용사 prejudiced와 and로 병렬되는 자리이므로, 명사 bias가 아니라 형용사 biased가 와야 한다. bias → biased
det.tip: bias(명사) → biased(형용사). prejudiced와 병렬되는 형용사
